command: set -eu; test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "4298788b081fb16c4237f7655b32f7a81c279723"; export JAVA_HOME=$(/usr/libexec/java_home -v 21); export PATH="$JAVA_HOME/bin:$PATH"; ./gradlew :feature:telemetry:detekt >/tmp/telemetry-detekt.log 2>&1 || true; echo '--- detekt log ---'; tail -120 /tmp/telemetry-detekt.log; echo '--- reports ---'; find feature/telemetry/build/reports -maxdepth 3 -type f -print 2>/dev/null | sort; for f in feature/telemetry/build/reports/detekt/detekt.txt feature/telemetry/build/reports/detekt/detekt.xml feature/telemetry/build/reports/detekt/detekt.md; do if [ -f "$f" ]; then echo "--- $f ---"; sed -n '1,220p' "$f"; fi; done
